tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the services Alphamotion (Mumbai, India) publishes on alphamotion.in: digital marketing, websites and ecommerce stores, marketplaces, operations, compliance and finance, with a summary and the page to read, plus the three published prices.

tools.name: recommend_services
tools.description: Recommend the Alphamotion services that fit a business need, such as a website or ecommerce store, marketing, marketplace management, or operations in India. Returns the best matches with their pages. Only three services carry a published price; everything else is quoted to the work.

tools.name: request_contact
tools.description: Ask Alphamotion to get in touch on the user's behalf. Only use this when the user has agreed to share these details with Alphamotion, and set user_consented to true. Nothing is booked, priced or agreed by this request.
